preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_class WHERE relname = 'flow' AND relkind IN ('r','p')

changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE flow ( flow_ts timestamptz NOT NULL, received_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), delta_switched bigint NOT NULL, -- proration range start (netflow.delta_switched) last_switched bigint NOT NULL, -- proration range end (netflow.last_switched) first_switched bigint, bytes bigint, packets bigint, sampling_interval double precision, direction text, -- INGRESS / EGRESS (Directional<>) application text, -- netflow.application convo_key text, -- netflow.convo_key src_addr inet, dst_addr inet, protocol smallint, dscp smallint, -- DscpFilter + LimitedCardinalityField.DSCP exporter_node_id integer, -- ExporterNodeFilter input_snmp integer, -- SnmpInterfaceIdFilter (input) output_snmp integer, -- SnmpInterfaceIdFilter (output) location text, document jsonb NOT NULL -- full enriched flow ) PARTITION BY RANGE (flow_ts);

changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE flow_agg ( window_start timestamptz NOT NULL, window_end timestamptz NOT NULL, exporter_node_id integer NOT NULL, if_index integer NOT NULL, dscp smallint, -- with-TOS DSCP; NULL = without-TOS rollup dimension text NOT NULL, -- INTERFACE | APPLICATION | CONVERSATION | HOST grouped_by_key text, -- dimension value; NULL for INTERFACE totals bytes_in bigint NOT NULL, bytes_out bigint NOT NULL, congestion_encountered boolean NOT NULL, non_ecn_capable_transport boolean NOT NULL, hostname text, -- only populated for HOST rows writer_id text NOT NULL -- distinguishes partials from multiple writers ) PARTITION BY RANGE (window_start);
